standard.note: Final step of the 2018 'grand bargain' (Chapter 121 of the Acts of 2018). Flat since 2023 with no escalator.

tipped.note: M.G.L. c.151 sec.7 -- and Massachusetts requires the tip-credit test to be met over each SHIFT, not averaged across a pay period.

knownGaps: Massachusetts's premium-pay (Sunday/holiday retail) rules interact with this rate but are out of scope.
